address: GF, The Peninsula Manila, Corner of Ayala and Makati Avenues, Makati - Metro Manila, The Philippines
bio: Pass through the lobby of The Peninsula to enter an elegant Art Deco setting for a timeless fine dining experience. At Old Manila, French classics with bold touches meet aged steaks and refined seafood, all presented with care. The gracious hospitality and beautifully composed plates are in keeping with the restaurant's long-standing reputation, making this a fitting choice for special occasions and a showcase of Manila's enduring culinary class.
